answer: Make newcomers drop a ferrous anchor before they can trade: three anchor links, each a signed record of useful work checked by a different veteran, chained so a duplicate shows repeated signers and is cut loose. The anchor is rooted in cedar stakes, a small deposit locked while the newcomer proves itself across unrelated domains, released in slices as fresh jobs are verified. Each job adds one timber notch to a tally of distinct counterparties, so no clique can inflate it. Sybil farms must forge anchors, plant stakes, and fill timber tallies per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
